meta.defaultDesc: RITZ develops and manufactures current and voltage transformers, sensors, busbars and cast resin parts from 0.72 to 550 kV – since 1945, with plants in Europe, China and the USA.

nav.megaToolsText: Check specifications, size transformers, prepare inquiries.
nav.megaFinderText: Filter more than 290 types by voltage level, primary current, accuracy class and standard, configure them and send an inquiry.
nav.megaCompanyText: Owned by the RITZ Foundation, based in Hamburg since 1945.
nav.megaCareerText: More than 20 professions at sites in Europe, China and the USA.

footer.lead: Instrument transformers, sensors, busbars and cast resin parts for power supply – developed and manufactured in Europe, China and the USA.
footer.funding: Funded by the German Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Energy on the basis of a decision by the German Bundestag
footer.privacyNote: This website uses no cookies and no tracking.

areaLong.giessharzteile-duromer: Cast resin parts and systems by DUROMER

areaShort.niederspannung: Current transformers for metering and protection, voltage transformers and damping units up to 3.6 kV.
areaShort.mittelspannung: Current, voltage and combined transformers for indoor and outdoor use, touch-proof, for rail, generators and power quality.
areaShort.hochspannung: Oil-paper insulated current, voltage and combined transformers and capacitor voltage transformers up to 550 kV.
areaShort.elektronik-sensoren: Electronic transformers for DC and AC measurement and passive low-power sensors for smart grids.
areaShort.stromschienen-sis: Fully insulated, capacitively graded busbars for high currents in tight spaces, plus bushings.
areaShort.giessharzteile-duromer: Cast resin systems, moulded parts and solid-insulated devices – from formulation to series production.

feat.cap_tap: Capacitive tap / CK terminal / capacitive divider
feat.head: Head design

group.ns.special: Wound, interposing, summation and special current transformers

groupText.ms.pq: Broadband current, voltage and combined transformers with optionally extended frequency range up to 9 kHz.
groupText.ms.metalclad: Fully earthed metal enclosure and inner-cone connection – for gas- and air-insulated switchgear.
groupText.ms.rail: For rail vehicles and stationary railway applications, compliant with EN 50463 and TSI LOC&PAS.
groupText.ms.generator: For very high currents, with compensating windings against external fields.
groupText.ms.special: High-current, auxiliary-supply, explosion-protected and other special designs.
groupText.ms.combined: Current and voltage transformer in one unit – saves space and a metering panel.
groupText.ms.indoor.ct: Support, block and bushing-type current transformers to DIN 42600 and international standards.
groupText.ms.indoor.vt: Single- and double-pole voltage transformers in narrow, small and large designs.
groupText.ms.outdoor.ct: Weather-resistant cycloaliphatic epoxy resin; support, head and cascade designs.
groupText.ms.outdoor.vt: Single- and double-pole outdoor voltage transformers up to 72.5 kV.
groupText.ms.new: New types in the medium-voltage range.
groupText.ns.window: For cables and busbars, in ring-core and frame-core designs.
groupText.ns.bushing: Cast resin insulated current transformers for indoor and outdoor use.
groupText.ns.splitcore: Two-part design for retrofitting without disconnecting conductors – also for earth-fault detection.
groupText.ns.special: For metering and protection, switch strips, high currents and laboratory use.
groupText.ns.vt: Single-, double- and three-phase low-voltage transformers.
groupText.ns.accessory: Ferroresonance damping and additional burden for correct loading.
groupText.es.current: Passive low-power current transformers, also split-core and three-phase.
groupText.es.voltage: Passive low-power voltage transformers for indoor and outdoor use.
groupText.es.combi: Current and voltage sensor in support-type design.
groupText.es.electronic: DC and AC measuring systems based on the zero-flux principle, with isolation or buffer amplifier and optical transmission.
groupText.es.accessory: Buffer amplifier and open-circuit voltage protection.
groupText.hv.all: Manufactured in the USA, designed to international standards.
